item.title: Open call: 2026 Pro Helvetia residency programme
item.description: Pro Helvetia has opened its annual call for its international residency programme, which supports artistic exchange, research and professional development through extended stays in new cultural contexts. The programme allows selected artists and cultural practitioners to spend up to three months in Switzerland or in regions served by Pro Helvetia’s liaison offices. item.title: SA rapper Usimamane featured on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa
item.description: South African rapper Usimamane will feature on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa this month, as host Nandi Madida and global editorial head of hip hop and R&B, Ebro Darden, discuss his latest single, Racks, and his project G-Wagon Music: Baby Tai. Hailing from Umlazi, Usimamane has emerged as one of South Africa’s rising hip hop voices. item.title: Maskandi Fest Johannesburg to celebrate Zulu music, culture on 23 May
item.description: Maskandi Fest Johannesburg will take place on 23 May 2026 at Mary Fitzgerald Square, bringing traditional Zulu music and cultural expression to the city in a full-day event scheduled from 10am to 8pm. The festival coincides with Mother’s Day celebrations and is positioned as a family-oriented cultural gathering. item.title: Bubele Booi to debut as Vumaala at Johannesburg performance
item.description: Grammy-nominated producer Bubele Booi will stage a live performance on 23 January, marking the debut of his work as a performer under the name Vumaala. The event, titled Moya, will take place at The Artistry in Sandton, Johannesburg. It will also coincide with the release of Vumaala’s new single, ‘Memeza’, which will be made available on the day of the performance. ‘Memeza’ features South African artist Masi Buzani from the Eastern Cape. item.title: SA: Vusi Mahlasela announces new album
item.description: South African music veteran Vusi Mahlasela, widely regarded as “The Voice,” is preparing a major comeback with a new album scheduled for release in February 2026. Known for his distinctive blend of folk, jazz, and African rhythms, Mahlasela has been a prominent figure in the nation’s music scene for over three decades. item.title: Merlin signs AI licensing partnership with Udio
item.description: Merlin, the digital music licensing organisation representing independent record labels and distributors, has entered into a new partnership with AI music creation platform Udio, establishing a licensed framework for the use of independent music in artificial intelligence training. Under the agreement, Udio will train new AI models using music licensed from participating Merlin members. item.title: MaxNote Media acquires Eden Groove Sounds to boost African electronic music
item.description: South African independent music company MaxNote Media has acquired Eden Groove Sounds as part of a strategy to increase its release output and strengthen pathways for African electronic music into international markets. The acquisition is intended to expand MaxNote Media’s release pipeline while positioning Eden Groove Sounds as a dedicated imprint focused on long-term artist development and catalogue growth. item.title: Open call: Mahindra Fusion Fest 2026 in SA
item.description: Mahindra Fusion Fest 2026 has opened a nationwide call for entries, inviting creatives across South Africa to participate in a talent competition spanning music, fashion and art. The open call forms part of the festival’s broader programme and is positioned as a platform for emerging and independent creators to showcase their work in front of a national audience. item.title: Mahindra Fusion Fest 2026 returns to Pretoria
item.description: Mahindra Fusion Fest 2026 will return to the SunBet Arena at Time Square in Pretoria this March, with organisers confirming an expanded programme that combines live music, fashion and visual art in a single, curated event. Following its inaugural edition, the festival is set to once again position itself as a platform for collaboration across creative disciplines. item.title: Ndlovu Youth Choir announces 2026 SA tour dates
item.description: The Ndlovu Youth Choir has announced a South African tour for 2026, marking its first major local run since achieving international recognition as finalists on America’s Got Talent in 2019. The tour will open at Cape Town’s Artscape Opera House, with performances scheduled from 5 to 8 February 2026, before concluding at the Teatro at Montecasino in Johannesburg from 30 July to 2 August 2026.
